_doc: Per-package Python coverage floors, enforced in CI by
MONOTONIC RATCHET: raise a floor when the checker suggests it; never
lower one to make a PR pass. Replaces the old flat --cov-fail-under=61
kimctl 70.75%, total 72.74%. Floors = floor(measured) - 2 because CI
runs on Linux and skips platform-specific branches (macOS/Windows-only
code paths), so CI percentages can sit slightly below the local ones.
